findings.explanation: The sole recognized complete safe-failure reason is emergency_recovery_deadline. The independent retirement verifier requires original 4-second invocation identity, contiguous pre-cancel observations, all admitted six-tick step receipts, bounded leases, original 48-tick emergency history, unchanged supervisor deadline/quiet ordering and original topology/generation. Unverified retirement aborts.

Revocation checks original actor incarnation, physical state, control-generation increment and cleared action/edge/lease. Missing cancellation or durable retirement proof is an integrity error, not a complete failure or successful invocation; the same retired lifetime cannot restart.

Safe failure uses zero terminal bootstrap without an invented model forward, task terminal or penalty; cutoff-peek retirement takes precedence over administrative cutoff while retaining the raw per-tick cutoff. Value-less emergency overrides cannot acquire actor/critic losses. GAE stops at terminal, invalid/overridden transitions and cutoff under the original gamma/lambda per tick.

BC uses all eligible ordinary teacher labels including unsuccessful episodes, no outcome filtering, 40 epochs with recurrent prefix burn-in and original loss weights. PPO authenticates original stochastic proposal/value and immutable BC base before updates, preserves recurrent masks and resets, and requires exactly 256 confirmed six-tick decisions for each of 24 updates. Seeds are 190103, 190207, 190301; PPO case stream is precomputed independently per seed with seed+300000, 2048 entries per seed, without outcome-driven replacement.

findings.topic: Six finals, split holdouts and all sealed comparisons
findings.explanation: All six fixed BC/residual final checkpoint hashes must exist and be durably frozen before sealed outcomes. The independently audited sealed marker precedes the first sealed case, including authored/idle; the exact fixed case-major order covers 32 open diagnostic and 224 sealed rows. Original failed experiment had five finals, no barriers, zero evaluation rows, and is not upgraded into a successful or trained experiment. Contact/approach and complete opened-inventory split checks reject leakage.

Qualification retains mean final arrival >=0.75, each seed >=0.50, own-initial mean gain >=0.125 and strictly positive lower 95 percent bound over all 27 three-policy-seed resamples, original authored improvement/alternate high-baseline completion rule, ordinary trim +0.5/s, angle +0.1 rad, toward-speed ratio 0.7-1.5, purposeful-airborne loss <=0.125, every-case inference p95 <=5 ms, and zero integrity/admission failures. Every safe failure remains in its declared case denominator.

findings.topic: Original evidence and watchdog failure propagation
findings.explanation: The 8 GiB/250 ms original-tree watchdog checks sampled RSS and PID identity and rejects unreadable live RSS, but is explicitly soft, not a kernel hard ceiling. Observation, source-based audit, lifecycle and independently observed CLI exit must all report complete; watchdog or evidence failure forces nonzero/failure and never upgrades a failed allocation. The original source has no automatic retry.
